scope: Offline replay of preselected discrepancy columns; not held-out/full-field/physical validation. Negative band keeps a phase open but adds no negative impulse. No production rule or tolerance changes and no winning policy selected.
conclusion: Four large between-backend disagreements in available pressure traces collapse below 0.01 Pa s at eight ambient spacings (0.0625 Pa), while three smaller disagreements remain. Production pressure is absent for the fifth problematic phase point; its original label cannot be recomputed from a recorder-only trace. No band is selected or adopted; independent/full-field/product validation is still required.
analyticCounterexample: At 1 Pa peak, a sustained -0.05 Pa interval separates two positive phases. The 0.0625 Pa band merges them: impulse rises from 0.016 to 0.028 Pa s (+75%). At 10/100 Pa scaling the same proportional waveform does not merge. This is a mathematical counterexample, not CFD/physical validation.
